midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Primary text, filled CTA buttons, icon fills, card borders — black on white is the entire contrast system; no blue or colored accent dilutes it

pure-canvas.$description: Pure Canvas — Page background, card surfaces, button text on dark backgrounds, nav surfaces

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary body text, footer links, supporting labels

slate.$description: Slate — Tertiary body copy, descriptive paragraphs, helper text in feature sections

ash.$description: Ash — Muted captions, attribution text, ratings sub-labels

fog.$description: Fog — Footer section headings, disabled labels

silver.$description: Silver — Hairline borders, disabled button backgrounds

warm-sand.$description: Warm Sand — Active nav item highlight text — the single warm accent in an otherwise achromatic nav bar

party-pink.$description: Party Pink — Hero gradient start — soft pink-violet wash over photography

sky-periwinkle.$description: Sky Periwinkle — Section gradient accent — soft blue tint fading to white for feature-section backgrounds

spearmint.$description: Spearmint — Decorative surface gradient — teal-to-pale wash used in invitation card previews

midnight-blue.$description: Midnight Blue — Deep brand accent in invitation templates and decorative event card designs

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

partiful-display-medium.$description: Hero headlines and section display titles only — this custom face is the brand's signature; its slightly rounded geometric letterforms at weight 500 read as celebratory without being childish. Used exclusively for the largest type on any screen.

twk-lausanne-pan.$description: Everything else: nav links, body copy, card labels, buttons, captions, and the massive 112px decorative numeral at weight 825. The variable weight axis means the entire type system runs through one family — 400 for prose, 550-650 for UI emphasis, 700 for section headings, 825 only for oversized display numerals. The tight -0.04em tracking at bold weights and -0.02em at regular weights gives text a snug, editorial density uncommon in event apps.

sfnsdisplay-sfnstext.$description: System UI fallback appearing in app-like micro-UI contexts (notification previews, in-app RSVP widget). Renders as San Francisco on Apple devices — not a brand choice but a functional system font for OS-native feeling components.
